entities.name: Ycf17 (48 aa query)
observations: The 48-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt P51355 Ycf17 from Porphyra purpurea (100% identity and coverage; E-value 1.45e-30).
Ycf17 annotation suggests a possible role in chlorophyll and/or carotenoid binding; plastid/chloroplast localization is annotated for the exact reference.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 5,540.5 Da, theoretical pI 8.19, GRAVY 0.4875; these are unmodified-sequence estimates.
